_comment: ⟪meaningsClarity Addendum A, TQ 2026-11-11: an element's explorer page and its URI page must match⟫ THE WORDS OF AN ELEMENT'S MEANING FACTS, one list for both pages. The one reader (server/lib/edc-resolver/elementMeaningFacts.js) builds its sections in sectionNameList's order and its lines (lineList) in these words; the /edc element page (server/lib/edc-resolver/humanPage.js) and the explorer (MeaningFactsSection.vue) draw those lines and read their headings here. A {name} in a template is filled by a wording function that refuses a missing name.

sectionTitleByName.propertyMeanings: As the domain of property meanings
sectionTitleByName.valueMeanings: As the domain of value meanings
sectionTitleByName.namingMeanings: Named by meanings of other domains

unplacedValueGroupText: under no property meaning of this domain
_namingGroup: ⟪review S3⟫ a naming group is the meanings of one other domain held by one property meaning (that meaning and its values), so its line links to that meaning, whose level lists those values; the words say how the line's count relates to it. A slot is named by its slot name (hubCardTupleRules' slotList), one word list
namingNoHolderTemplate: {valueCount} values held by no property meaning
mappedSectionNoteText: Meanings this element is mapped to.
noMeaningText: No meaning names this element, and it is mapped to none.
_meaningTitle: ⟪meaningsClarity Addendum B⟫ a meaning's visible title, on its explorer panel and its /edc page, and what it is underneath by tier; a tier not named here says its tier as written

meaningSubtitleTemplateByTier.value: one code of a property in the {hubName} domain {domainName}
meaningSubtitleTemplateByTier.term: one {hubName} term, meant on its own

loadingText: Reading the meanings it takes part in…
unreadableText: The meanings it takes part in could not be read just now.
